question: With which of the following organs of the human body is the discipline called hepatology concerned?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Liver.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The field of medicine known as** hepatology** focuses on ailments relating to and** affecting the liver.**
 
• A specialist in the **diagnosis and treatment of hepatic illnesses**, which include conditions affecting your liver, gallbladder, and pancreas, is known as a** hepatologist.**
 
• The** liver performs** the following five primary tasks:

 1. Filtration.

 2. Digestion.

 3. Detoxification and metabolism.

 4. Protein production

 5. Vitamin and mineral storage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cirrhosis, fatty liver disease, and hepatitis, **among other disorders, have an increasing impact on millions of people's lives each year, making liver problems a** global problem.**
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 The Greek terms** "hepatikos" and "logia," **which indicate liver and study, respectively, are the source of the word **"hepatology."**
